manifest.description: Diagnose Rust structs whose fields and receiver-based behavior collapse unrelated state ownership into one architectural owner.
when_to_use: one struct is the only path to config, stores, caches, runtime handles, provider metadata, and request state
field clusters and method clusters look unrelated but legal to the compiler
a correction plan may use rust-state-extract or sequence state extraction with rust-split-god-impl
anti_patterns: do not use for field count alone
do not use for Arc<Mutex<T>> or Rc<RefCell<T>> proliferation without an ownership or lifecycle claim
do not use on non-Rust targets
